One enormous hollow wooden Trojan horse, visibly made from timber planks with the same golden bronze bands, mounted on the same four-wheeled timber platform. Its four rigid wooden legs never walk, its head never moves, and its wheels rotate only while pulled. One rectangular hinged hatch on its camera-facing belly and one wooden ladder. The belly hatch is shut and no ladder is visible. No Greek soldier is visible. [Shot 1] Sunset. New wide shot of the central square.
